utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Good morning, everyone. When one is logged on at the courtroom it cannot log in in your chambers, so I was not able to check the transcript of yesterday. But there seems to have been a misunderstanding on my part when, Mr. Karadzic and Mr. Robinson, you raised the issue of G17 issue. What was the -- what was the point of the request for reconsideration?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. President. As Dr. Subotic was explaining yesterday during her testimony, in incident G13, it's her position that the damage that was done to the television building in G17 was actually part of a ricochet that was fired on the occasion of the incident of G13. And therefore, the information about that incident is directly relevant to the G13 incident.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes. My misunderstanding was that I thought mistakenly that while the Chamber allowed a part of G17 to remain in a report it inadvertently ordered redaction of 15 pages. It was not the case. In order to lead evidence in such a way, I think the Defence should have objected to the redaction when the Prosecution proposed the redaction. We didn't disallow the Prosecution to lead evidence on that issue and so it would be simply inconsistent and unfair to allow the Prosecution -- the Defence to lead evidence in such a detail. I remember we heard some evidence in a general -- in general terms and that's more than sufficient. So we'll not allow the accused to lead that part of evidence with Dr. Subotic. Please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Excellencies. Good morning to everyone.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Dr. Subotic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Excellencies, I'd like to clarify one issue from yesterday. What was discussed was the possibility of uploading only two pages connected to incident 17 which relate to incident 13. We did so. Can we perhaps have a look at it and then you can make a ruling as to whether you want to admit it. So not the entire incident 17, only those images that are related to incident 13 .

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think the Chamber has given its ruling. We'll not allow it. Please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Dr. Subotic, yesterday you said that it didn't have a foundation or that's to say that the physical traces did not allow for a conclusion that the incident involved fuel bomb. What else can you tell us about this incident, G13?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As for incident G13, the issue that we did not touch upon yesterday was that one needs to emphasise that the destructive effect of the bomb FAB-100 involving a solid explosive could not have been the result of a fuel air bomb. What happened in this instant was that the projectile hit a vehicle, penetrated the roof of the vehicle, or rather, of the building, it broke through the roof slab of the building, and it also broke through the slab between the fifth and the fourth floors and inflicted injuries to the people who were on the fourth floor. Now, why do I say that it didn't involve a fuel bomb --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can I ask you to call up 1D7900, image 22. This was part of paragraph 47.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I apologise for interrupting you, but I believe this will be of use to you to refer to the image.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can continue in the meantime because I do see the image before me. The image does indicate or show the slab on the fifth floor that was torn through. Now, on the fifth floor where the bomb was, in fact, activated as it came into contact with the floor, we do have a survivor, an eye-witness. So you would perhaps wonder how a person managed to survive the impact of a 40-kilogramme bomb. It is possible because in the event that the person is behind a shelter, that would be the result of this blast effect bomb. The second survivor eye-witness sustained serious injuries as a result of him finding himself under the rubble in between the two floors. The important issue is that in this instant there would not have been any survivors had the impact involved a bomb with fuel air filling.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. You said as a wall, as a pillar, and this isn't reflected in the transcript. That's in reference to line 21.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we only have the English version, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us what sort of force is required to break through the armature and can this be done by fuel air explosive?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, definitely not, not a fuel air bomb. This also indicates the fact that this wasn't a large bomb. There are no thick walls and this is an indication of the fact that what was used here was a bomb of inferior power, a FAB-100. We can also see the incoming trajectory here, but without going into details because I do believe that they could only confuse us.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can I now ask you to look at incident G14 and tell us what it is that the physical traces indicate in this particular instance.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the incident at Dositejeva Street 4A. It's presented in figure 45. This is a park skirted by a number of buildings, and the building that was hit housed some sort of a representation office.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we see image 45. This is part of paragraph 64 of the document.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, it's not -- it wasn't a representation office, rather it was the building of the Presidency in line 20.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us now by reference to the figure what it is that you were saying?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I said that the location was restricted within the red lines that we showed here. It's a park area in the centre of town where the command of the 1st Corps of the BH is housed, the CSB, the Presidency of the BH, the command of the 105th Brigade. At any rate, the area outside of these dotted lines indicates the residential area.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What do the physical traces tell us about the device that exploded and where it had come from?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We agreed that there are two directions or trajectories that were at play before we got involved in the analysis to see if we could facilitate the process. These two directions were distributed by the CSB and they were 348 plus/minus 10 --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: And can Dr. Subotic repeat Dr. Zecevic's figure.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 315 plus/minus 10. We agreed that in our view the direction or the trajectory that was more likely was the one that was established by the CSB on the basis of the rocket engines that we -- that were uncovered the trajectory defined by the CSB was more likely. This was the effect of FAB-100 with a solid explosive filling.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at image or figure 50. This is part of paragraph 75.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You were speaking of the trajectories. Can you tell us which is more likely and why?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: One of the trajectories was established by the CSB and it fits with the physical traces that can be seen based on the traces of the rocket engines. The other trajectory was established by Mr. Zecevic without providing any explanation. I don't think his reconstruction of the launching of the projectile fits really with the possibilities of the system. He believed that the launcher was placed within the Pretis compound. This is not to be expected in view of the distances involved and I don't think that anybody can support that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: According to Zecevic, it would have had to fly over Brdo -- the Hum hill?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's trajectory 2 and that's pretty distant. Now, the CSB defined trajectory which we believe fits with the physical traces is trajectory 1, that's 315 plus/minus 10.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Perhaps we should make pauses and speak slowly --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Doctor, did you have something to say?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I wanted to say that I apologise. I may have rushed when speaking. That's the only thing I wanted to say.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Please continue.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us this: As for these trajectories, 1 and 2, what is the --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: -- geography down on the ground and what is the density of the population?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I think everybody seems to have a problem with personal LiveNote. I tried to fix it myself but it doesn't seem to work. It's better to have a short break for five minutes. We'll rise for five minutes. --- Break taken at 9.20 a.m.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Dr. Subotic, could you please focus on what we have on the screen right now. Taking into account the infrastructure, the mortars, the command posts, and in image 45 we can see that the Presidency building is 80 metres away from the impact site. Taking into account both distances, how would you assess the precision of this hit?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Taking into account everything that you just mentioned, the precision from the ballistics point of view is practically directly at the target which is part of the VVEP as I said yesterday, this meant 50 per cent of hits. So it is quite close and that is expected, taking into account the dispersion. Because for such a distance we were working with average distance, the VD for this projectile is 102 metres.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said 102 metres for 1?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to the calculations and the tables for one projectile propelled by rockets FAB-100, 1VD, so one probable table deviation is 102 metres, and we are within a smaller deviation of 1VD which is very precise.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Did you come across a piece of information that in Dositejeva Street itself at that number or neighbouring number there was some military --

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that we noted here everything that we established; namely, that the Presidency of the BiH, the Sarajevo CSB, and the command of the 1st Corps of the BH army, the command of the 105th Brigade were all located there. The brigade was the mountain brigade. We note all that in our report, everything that we found in documents.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. I started before the break, I was about to ask you about the geography and the population along the one and the other possible trajectories.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the population along the trajectory that we agree with according to the findings of the CSB is practically the sparsest in the area covered by the triangle created by the directions that we depict here, whereas the other trajectory which is not well argumented and which is noted by my colleague Mr. Zecevic without explanation in his report, I think that he said that he would avoid areas populated by the Serbs. But I would not claim that before having another look at the document.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you please tell us if you know when the CSB conducted the on-site investigation and when did Berko Zecevic do so?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As far as I know, Berko Zecevic conducted his on-site investigation later and the CSB conducted it - let me just look here because I don't remember any longer - I think on the same day or was this the instance when it occurred later?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could I ask you to tell us what the material evidence represents, paragraph 56, image 33, that's the previous incident Safeta Hadzica Street number 102.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just a second. Let me find the image.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: G13, paragraph 56.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And for others I'm looking for G13, paragraph 56, image 33 is what I would like us to see on the screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us what this image with fragments tells us about the direction and the incoming trajectory and what hit here?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: What obviously hit here --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we please zoom in to the image so that we see the image only on the screen.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] As can be seen from this photograph, the building was hit with a projectile of a smaller calibre, that's a mortar projectile, and the incoming trajectory was upwards. There is a slight deviation from the normal line if we take that the building is against a horizontal direction. So this is a hit with a mortar shell or projectile of a smaller calibre, and the shell came upwards from a lower position.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. What tells us that it's directed upwards?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, from quite close because, as we know, mortar projectiles have a high trajectory and this came from quite close. It could have been done by mistake, but certainly from quite close. When I say that the velocity's also high, we talk about -- we talk about particular trajectories, and it's quite obvious from this image that it was fired from quite close, from a small distance.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It was not recorded it was done either deliberately or by mistake. Can you tell us what tells you in this image how you decide that it came from down and that the trajectory was an upward trajectory?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a typical image of the effect of a mortar projectile, where the central crater is marked by the first row of traces and the other one which is created by shrapnel tells us from which direction the shell arrived. If you were to depict it as a horizontal level, you would see that it had come upwards from a position down from here and directed upwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, when you tried to correct the transcript, it is important to get the confirmation of the witness; otherwise, there would be no way for us to check it later. So I take it that it is true you said, Doctor, that it was not recorded that it was done either deliberately or by mistake? Do you confirm having said that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I just wanted to say that such a hit could be created in these two ways.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, do you think it would be useful if you were to draw a letter T across this image so as to show us how this proves that it had arrived from the said direction? I mean, if you made a drawing around the crater with an electronic pen.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can Dr. Subotic please receive some help with the electronic pen.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The first and second rows of traces and the incoming trajectory.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What is that?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: That's the central crater, how it is oriented.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please mark it with number 1.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks] This is the second one.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And now the direction, please, if you can.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This would be the approximate direction. All is put in a certain perspective.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you put number 3 next to the direction.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Which side was in a position to fire this shell?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Judging by the position that we analysed, this shell could have arrived only from the side of the ABiH, from the separation line. And we based that on the situation as it was at the moment.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can this be admitted as a separate document.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the witness and the accused please be asked not to overlap.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please sign this document.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: What date are we today?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The 14th of May.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, we'll receive it.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D3539.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise, can you please bear with me for a moment. Maybe it would be appropriate to draw the horizontal axis here in this image for a better understanding of the image.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can this be done? Can we plot the horizontal axis here?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we can, because it would be parallel with the top and bottom edges of the window. If you think that this is necessary ...

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I don't think so. Now you have explained that that would be parallel to the edges of the window. We can see that this is far below the horizontal line.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And what number has been given to this document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Shall we repeat it.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D3539.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Dr. Subotic, please pay attention to incident G15. Can you tell us in a nutshell what did the physical evidence demonstrate in this case? The square of international friendship on the 16th of June, 1995.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, there was an explosion and based on the physical evidence that we found on the site, the explosion was caused by an modified bomb FAB-250. It was activated on a trail in front of the building number 10. It created certain traces, a crater, the fragments on the nearby high-rise building. There was a -- the building of local commune there and the civilian protection and people were present there when that happened. Based on the size of the crater, it was established what bomb was in question, FAB-250 with classical explosives, since the bomb exploded in the ground as you see on figure 54 --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Can the witness be asked to slow down, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Doctor, could you speak a bit more slowly and then could you --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you repeat your answer.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Before that, I would like to call up image 52, 53, and 54, all those are within paragraph 81.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'll start to repeat my answer slowly, if that is okay.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Please try not to overlap with the interpretation. So please wait before you start answering the question. Yes. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Based on physical evidence which was found in the field and on the photographs, in this case on a passenger footpath near building number 10, a modified air bomb FAB-250 was activated. Based on the size of the crater and the fragmentation effect on the high-rise building which was caused by the particles of the bomb which did not land in the ground, we were able to ascertain what kind of a bomb that was. No other bomb could have created such a crater, not the FAB-100 bomb or an area bomb for that matter. And there is another piece of evidence corroborating the fact that this was not an area bomb. The people who were there in front of the building when the bomb was activated were not harmed, they remained alive. When we investigated this incident a very good sketch of the site was drafted. However, a mistake was made in marking the north.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Before that, Doctor, can I ask you, first of all, when you say an "air bomb," can you replace that word with "fuel air bomb"? And now I would like to zoom in on the facade of the building and I would like you to explain what you found on the facade. You mentioned some fragmentation effects.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can the photos at the bottom be zoomed in on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, I didn't follow when you said replacing the word "air bomb" with "fuel air bomb." Could you clarify with the Doctor.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, you use a technical term "area bomb." Do you have in mind fuel air bombs when you say that?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's one in the same. These two are synonyms.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. This is what I wanted. Unlike TNT air bomb, when you say an "area bomb" what you mean is a "fuel air bomb"; right?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [In English] "Area bomb," I think it is making some confusion. It's not "area." "Spatial" would be -- rather, "spatial." [Interpretation] Can you tell us what you concluded when looking at the facade and then we will move on to the sketch that you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I said that the high up on the high-rise building there are traces of fragmentation effects and they can be seen very well in figure 54 and this was caused by the rear part of the projectile. I can mark them but I'm sure that you can see them very well because they're very well visible.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now look at figures 56 and 57 on the same page -- or rather, two pages further on.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And while we're waiting, if this had been a fuel air bomb, would we have ended up with such a crater and such a fragmentation effect on the facade? I'm talking about the previous image.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The answer's no, of course not. I've already said that a crater of that kind and such fragmentation effects could not have been caused even by a FAB-100 which contains about 40 kilos of explosive.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And now can you please tell us what is depicted in this map and then we will scroll down a little.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is an excerpt from Google Earth which depicts the place of the incident and the location of the Bitumenka factory.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we scroll up a little.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please comment.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the right-hand side is a sketch of the incident site which was drafted by a forensic expert when he investigated the site of the incident. And this sketch was used to determine the direction. I'm sure that you have noticed the mistake in determining the due north. The deviation was 57 degrees and this was confirmed with the forensic expert and confirmed by him. We have used his sketch of the site to determine the position of the launch place based on the position of the crater. This is direction 2 in figure 57. When it is plotted parallelly to the site of the incident, we can see that the trajectory is across the Bitumenka factory, which points to the fact that it was the factory that was the target of this shell.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And now can we go to the following page, i.e., to the following figure. Can you briefly explain this photo.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The figure depicts all the trajectories that were established during the investigation of this incident. Number 1 depicts what we determined based on the actual north and the sketch based on documents and the aerial orientation in space. Number 2 was determined by Berko Zecevic. This is interesting for the fact that he did not agree with the forensic expert and he determined his trajectory together with two other incidents, one which had happened 20 days before and the other one that happened 12 days after this incident. He merged them together, and based on that he determined trajectory 2, and trajectory 3 is the trajectory that was determined by the CSB, whereas bullet point 4, or rather, bullet point 5 is actually the position of the Bitumenka factory. Number 4 is the trajectory that was determined by the police based on the official note. The investigators themselves determined two trajectories. One was determined by the forensic expert and the other was based on the official note, and this was all shown in one figure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And now can we pay attention to incident 10 which happened in Hrasnica at the Alekse Santica school. We have finished with that.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Incident 10 happened in Alekse Santica Street, not at the Alekse Santica school.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I apologise. Can we then look at paragraph 100 and I'm interested in figure 73. Tell us what you concluded based on the physical evidence of this incident.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The incident is very clear in terms of physical evidence. The figure that you have called up shows everything as it was once the building was repaired. This photo was taken by Mr. Zecevic in 2007. So the physical evidence is not very visible here. The physical evidence is better depicted in figure 74. The photo is part of the photo documentation that was compiled by the investigative organs, and it perfectly shows that --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can -- I apologise. Can the following page be shown for the benefit of the witness. I'm interested in figure 74 and 75. Can you please continue and tell us what the difference is between the two photos. When did Zecevic take his photo and when did these two photos originate?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The previous photo taken by Zecevic was taken in 2007, and it shows that the building was repaired, that a new house was built in the left part of the photo. When you look at the previous photo documentation, you won't see here. It is not that the whole house was built, it was just reconstructed and you won't see that in any of the photos in the photo documentation. In our paper, this is figure 74. You can see the traces on the building that was -- that were created by the bomb. You can see that the bomb entered the bomb and exited after having done a certain trajectory through the ground and continued, and this was confirmed by the investigative organs. However, my colleague Mr. Zecevic did not agree with that. He had his own explanations about the impact of the fuel air bomb within the ground. In technical terms it was absolutely unacceptable. Actually, what happened was that the bomb landed on -- in the corner of the house. As you can see in figure 74 --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could the witness please slow down.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Interpreters were not able to catch up with your speed, Dr. Subotic. Yes, could you repeat from the part where you start explaining about figure 74.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise. I will do my best. I am under the impression that I'm speaking slowly. Based on the traces visible in figure 74, this was how the bomb travelled, in fact. In the spot marked with number 1 in the image, the bomb hit the house and tore away a part of it. We can even see the direction of impact. Along the direction shown by the arrow and at the tip of the arrow it penetrated the ground next to the overturned fence. At that point when the engines had already fallen off, it had deviated significantly from its initial trajectory and continued to travel up until Bunicki Potok Street, I believe the number was 73, and exploded there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us the physical evidence at the point of impact indicate what exactly?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think it's 233 or 133, the address on Bunicki Potok Street. It's not 73. I think it's -- let me just check.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Image 79, 233.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Bunicki Potok, 233. Let me just add that the technical parameters and the capabilities of a fuel air bomb complete with the physical traces on the site are simply insufficient. There isn't enough oxygen in the soil to allow for the creation of a fuel air cloud and for the bomb to be, in fact, activated.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we show figure 79, please. Can it be enlarged further.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us briefly what this figure illustrates?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The image was taken over from Mr. Zecevic's report. He illustrated the impossibility of the incoming trajectory from the ricochet point on Alekse Santica Street number 50, that it was impossible for the bomb to ricochet over there and land on Bunicki Potok Street number 233. In his analysis there is one issue that I don't understand why my colleague has overlooked. This isn't the classical ricochet. What was at play here was that the projectile penetrated into the soil and travelled a certain stretch within the soil. In the process, the engine was detached, which meant that the projectile lost its stability of flight. Secondly, as the environment changed, a deflection occurred because the resistant coefficient of such a dense environment as soil is is immeasurably higher than that of air. Another noteworthy point is something that we, members of the profession, are fully versed with because we've seen it numerous times and we used it to test the resilience of a casing, we do cause the projectile to penetrate the soil and then come out of it again. We want to see the state the casing is in, and it is precisely this sort of effect that we would observe, that's to say a very sharp deflection to the left or to the right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you now briefly present to us incident 928 of July 1995 --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: While the picture is before us, could you read the yellow letters which appears between Alekse Santica Street number 50 and Bunicki Potok number 233. Because it was not translated. Could you read it out for the benefit of us so that we can hear the interpretation. Do you see the 140 metres --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In the bottom part of the figure --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: In the picture.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes, the bottom part of the image; right?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Which appears above Bunicki Potok number 233, which start from "rikose ..."

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes, I'll read it out for you. It reads: "The projectile cannot possibly ricochet in this direction!!!" And this is in fact what I was saying a moment ago that the image was taken over from where -- in fact, it is clearly seen that the ricochet cannot possibly happen in this direction.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Dr. Subotic, how many points do you have -- the transcript seems to reflect that this is your view that the ricochet is impossible, or is it your view or is it a view that you criticised a moment ago?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I will answer this. It wasn't my understanding, but let me repeat, this isn't my view, this isn't my opinion, and I've explained the reasons why I believe it to be inaccurate. I've merely read out what my colleague wrote on an image that we've taken over in order to be able to provide our comments of it, we've taken it over from his report.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Rest assured, I think it's clear. Even Ms. Gustafson would not challenge it, it's from Mr. Zecevic's report. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, can you tell us from that corner of the house that was torn away through to Bunicki Potok, how many points do you have to establish the trajectory, the corner of the house? How many points in the ground could this line therefore be established on the basis of how many points?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the first point is the damage to the house. The second point is not -- but is only approximate, it is the point where the projectile penetrates the ground. We have a clear point where the projectile leaves the ground and we have the point of impact on Bunicki Potok Street, if that's what you had in mind.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes. This statement here that it was impossible prompted me to ask you to tell us on the basis of how many points you can draw this line?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Let me just make a few points. What colleague Zecevic said holds true if what we have is a vertical surface, but we had the horizontal surface and then the penetration of the ground wherein the physical process is completely different.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, does this look like the game of drakes and dragons when you're skimming the earth with pebbles?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, it does a bit. In this, of course, event you would have a pebble entering water and then leaving it again, which is not normally the case.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Let's look at incident 9, 28 July 1995, Cetinjska Street, paragraph 108 and onwards. Can you briefly present this incident?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'll try to make it brief. This is a FAB-250 modified aerial bomb which impacted the ninth floor and you can see that clearly on figure 82. The assertions made in respect of this case were varied and all of them were presented in detail in this report. Let us not dwell on those. In short, based on the trace evidence found on this high-rise building it was established that the incoming trajectory practically ran north-south, that the bomb was activated on the ninth floor, what are the traces that we're referring to? Well, the ones that are visible on the high-rise building itself, first of all. We are looking at the traces of soot on the slab on the ninth floor and the traces found around the building and the effect that the bomb would produce does fit with those and with the trajectory that I indicated.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we look at figure 81. Can you tell us who took the photographs and what do they illustrate? How did you interpret the physical evidence they show?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: These -- the trace evidence was obtained from the CSB photo documentation. I think that the markings in yellow and red are by my colleague Mr. Zecevic. On the first photo on the left side, the traces that I referred to are clearly visible. On the right-hand side of the high-rise building, two slabs were destroyed and you can see the intense black of the soot on the ceiling of the ninth -- on the ninth floor. You can see that the projectile basically flew more or less in parallel to the disposition of the structure and this is clearly seen on figure 87 where we have indicated it as transposed upon a Google Earth image. On the basis of the traces on the ground, that's also figure 87, you can see the concrete beam that was knocked out and all the other traces. The lateral part opposite the yellow arrow faces north. So this part of the high-rise building was exposed to a lateral impact and it occurred on the ninth floor. And such a highly destructive force could only have come from a FAB-250 filled with a TNT explosive. What we also see here on figure 85 is a trace from a smaller projectile. This has nothing to do with the incoming trajectory of this particular bomb. On this issue we have the testimony of a witness who said that he first heard the impact and then went out to see what it was all about. When he went back in, that was when this other impact was heard, which means that the first impact was that of a mortar because its incoming trajectory does not fit with the incoming trajectory that we established based on the physical evidence and the destructive force that was visible on this high-rise building.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And in the event that the high-rise building had not been grazed but rather had the projectile flown in under a normal angle, what sort of damage could be expected? What would have become of this floor had it not grazed merely but had it been a direct hit, as it were?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I apologise, I don't understand the question.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Perhaps I'm not versed enough. You said that the projectile had flown in practically in parallel to the building?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, it was a right angle really, not in parallel to it --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Now please continue. Please bear in mind you should put a pause. Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The Doctor said that the angle was low or small, not a right angle.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And had the angle -- had this been at a right angle --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Mr. Karadzic, please confirm with the Doctor or you put the question again.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In line 18 it says that you said that it was a right angle. Did you say that this was an impact at a right angle?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I didn't say that it was at a right angle, that would be 90 degrees, and what we see here does not indicate something like that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And how do you know that it's not at a right angle? In other words, where would the damage be expected to be seen had the impact been at a right angle? At a right angle in respect of which particular direction or line?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, in respect of the high-rise building. Had it been at a right angle in respect of the surface of the high-rise building, the entire destructive effect would be focused on the building itself. We would not have such extensive physical evidence around the building. We would have the sort of traces that would be expected upon such an impact.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [In English] "In the building" instead of "on the building itself." [Interpretation] Did you say that the destructive building [as interpreted] would have been within the high-rise?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Within the high-rise and to the left and to the right in respect of the trajectory.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we show figures 84 and 85. You were talking about the traces outside of the high-rise building and a hole in the concrete which you established did not originate from the same projectile. What does this figure show?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This picture shows the effects of the impact on the ground around the high-rise that we talked about recently and the scattered fragments of various materials that were caused after the explosion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we please show image 85 now. Maybe we can just scroll down if it's on the same page. In the English version it's on the following page. What did you want to say about this hole in the plate? It seems to be a vertical shot or something.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the plate between the floors, between the seventh and eighth floors, and the investigating team said that it was caused by a fragment of the projectile, which suggests that by its dimensions it does not correspond to the dimensions of the FAB-250 projectile. And there is also the testimony of witnesses residing in the high-rise, which is included in the report, the resident who first heard the impact of this projectile and then after a while FAB-250 hit the same high-rise. It can be seen here that the trajectory does not correspond with incoming trajectory of the FAB-250. For the reason that in the photograph itself you can see the window in lower left-hand corner, the window is located on the northern side of the high-rise. And if the shell had arrived from there -- excuse me, not the shell but the FAB-250, then we would not have such traces, either on the high-rise itself or in the surroundings of the high-rise. So that leads us to conclude that this projectile arrived independently immediately before the impact of the FAB-250. It's elaborated in detail in the report. My colleague Mr. Zecevic was wrong about this. He simply did not dwell on the details sufficiently because if he had looked into the fact that we have undamaged windows, it would be clear to him that the orientation of the defect on the plate between the seventh and eighth floors is pointing to another direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we please now show figure 87 and if you can please explain to us what, according to your report, was the probable target here which was missed when the high-rise was grazed.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We can see here that we found the particular building in Google Earth. We then inserted the trajectory which we established on the basis of the material, traces of the impact on the high-rise itself. And one can see here that the trajectory is almost north to south. One can see that the particular trajectory leads across the part of the high-rise which was damaged. The high-rise is situated on a hill and the ordinate of the ninth floor is around 40 metres. And if there had been no impact against the high-rise, the modified bomb would continue its flight and end at the target which is marked by number 2 in the same image. And that is the Zica, or wire, factory. I have to note here that such an instance cannot be foreseen by any artillery crew member; namely, that such a building would come up along the trajectory and I think that this had to happen because if the bomb had been just 1 metre to the left it would have flown by. It just happened that the obstacle was at the height of the trajectory ordinate as the projectile was flying towards the target. And I think it's impossible to foresee such an incident unless you have a 3-D image of the terrain and software which can foresee what might happen.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you tell us generally speaking what were your conclusions in connection with the rocket propulsion of the bomb; namely, whether the bomb itself had been modified, what was the modification like, and what can you tell us about --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Could you expand, Doctor, about your basis upon which you could conclude that on the part of the -- those who fired the shell could not have anticipated such an obstacle. What is your basis?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm saying that because when the information is provided, when the data is provided, whether it's a system for directing fire or if the data is introduced manually from firing tables on the basis of the information collected and the other ballistics characteristics, such as the meteo-ballistics [Realtime transcript read in error "metal ballistics"] data, the distance, and everything else that is included in the parameters which are taken into account when the data important for the target is considered, there is no way to introduce the data which would say, for example, there is a high-rise obstacle at such and such a distance along the Y axis. There is no way to take that into account because whether it's the fire directing system or whether manually the parameters which are important for the flight would be introduced from firing tables, there is no possibility to take something like that into account. So what I'm telling you now and what I decided that -- on the basis of what I decided that is that such a facility simply happened to be along the Y axis of the trajectory at the moment when the projectile was launched. I hope that this explanation was sufficient.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: While we still have this image on the screen, Doctor, can you tell us what the sub-image A represents in this image. And in line 11 instead of "metal ballistics data," the doctor said "meteo-ballistic data." Perhaps you can tell us whether it was meteorological ballistics data or metal.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It had to do with meteorological ballistics data, or shortly, meteo-ballistics data.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And now if you can tell us what is in square A, number 1, in the lower right-hand corner, what does the right line represent in relation to the high-rise and how does that fit into what you just told us?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the incoming trajectory marked by line 1 and determined on the basis of the traces found at site in the surroundings of the high-rise and on the high-rise itself. It can be seen here precisely how it actually hit the high-rise and it fits perfectly with the traces which are evident on the high-rise itself and around it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Before the break, just a few brief questions. Did you analyse or conclude how many victims there were in the 16 or 17 incidents, the victims or casualties of aerial bombs in this part of the city?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think that we provide that in the A report and opinion and -- and that it's, I don't know, perhaps a dozen, 12, 13, 15, something like that, I don't know, I could only try and find that analysis and then I would be able to tell you. The targets ...

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: All right. We can do that after the break as well. But could you tell us --

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Here, I've got it. According to available information in 16 incidences, according to one set of information there were ten and according to another set of information, 11 persons who were killed; seriously wounded, four; and slightly wounded or slightly injured, 38. So in all 16 instances that we analysed, according to available information that we had at our disposal, that was the figure.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you then tell us on the basis of that something about the precision and the justification of the use of such projectiles against industrial zones judging by the number of casualties?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, as you can see from our report, we did analyse the precision of all the firing in relation to the targets that were targeted because this is the only way it can be done. We noted that of all the instances that were analysed, 43, or rather, 44 per cent hit the target, about 19 per cent, or rather, 18.7 per cent, was at a distance smaller than 0.5 VD and around 31 per cent was between 0.5 and 1.5 of the table deviations which in ballistics terms is completely correct and all right. We have only one firing which is outside the scope of three table deviation and this one instance could have been seen in a different light. There were two possible targets in that particular instance and we considered that instance of firing in relation to the greater distance, and in my view the precision, professionally speaking, was quite sufficient and fine. On the other hand, I think that the other part of your question had to do with the justification, how justified was it. Right. Considering the firing power, the number of projectiles that were fired, and the use of destructive explosive that was used and the number of casualties, it can be assessed that the bombs were primarily used as for or for destruction of facilities, buildings, and targets which were used in some other way rather than as buildings in which civilians resided because if that had not been the case the number of casualties would have been much greater. We have to take into account that each of these bombs carries at least 39 kilos of TNT and the FAB-250 are loaded with as much as 100 kilos.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And the last question before the break, Dr. Subotic: Was there any material trace or evidence that fuel air bombs were used?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: There are no material traces in all the evidence that a single fuel air bomb was used in the Sarajevo area, and I think this is presented in detail in the report. These were effects that were analysed in detail, the principles of action and all the collected material evidence.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Excellencies, I am looking at the clock. If it's the right time for the break, I think that this would be an opportune moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Ms. Gustafson.

utterances.speaker: MS. GUSTAFSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. I just would like to make a very minor point. We've referred in the last half an hour to incidents that the accused referred to as incidents 9 and 10. I just want to make clear, those are the numberings that the witness gave to some unscheduled incidents and they shouldn't be confused with G9 or G10. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, the Chamber is aware of that point. Thank you. We will take a break for half an hour and resume at seven past 11.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Dr. Subotic, before I move on to your next report I have a couple of brief questions for you. The precision that you just talked about, would it have been possible without the firing tables being used for the fuel that was used in this case?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Are you referring to the complete projectile equipped with rocket engines?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Yes. What is their significance? Would this kind of precision be achieved without firing tables?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In my view, this is impossible, absolutely impossible.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you know Pretis as a military factory? Did it have any software capabilities to conduct ballistics calculations; and if it did, how were these firing tables designed?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I co-operated with Pretis before the war. They did have software. They had a development department. My colleague Zecevic was a staff member there. According to my information, Professor Jankovic in Zagreb sold them the ballistics software. I know that because I was offered to co-operate on the software applications. They obviously had very good software and I'm sure that they had professionals who could use it, although I can't be sure of that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did Pretis have its own firing ranges in Bosnia-Herzegovina or in Republika Srpska during the war? Are you aware of some of them?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It had its factory firing range, but it was used for testing the function and not the external ballistics conditions. There was also a firing range in Kalinovik. I was there. I tested some of the assets to design firing tables. I'm not personally aware of any other firing ranges in that area.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you know if Pretis used certain other institutions in Serbia to design new firing tables and to test assets, both old and new?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I apologise. Are you referring to the same period of time or in general terms?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Before the war and during the war.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. There were such institutions and there were -- there are documents that we have had at our disposal to come up with our study. I know that assets were tested in --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Can the witness repeat the name of the place, the last word she said.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You said Nikica?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, Nikica is one of the firing ranges of the technical institute in the territory of the former Yugoslavia. It was the only institution that could check the quality of military products. One of the firing ranges was in Prevlaka, the third one was in Kalinovik, the fourth in Macedonia, and so on and so forth. There was a special institution called VOC which was an institution to test aircraft and air-borne assets.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Dr. Subotic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could 1D7900 be admitted? This is Dr. Subotic's report on modified air bombs.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Ms. Gustafson.

utterances.speaker: MS. GUSTAFSON
utterances.text: No objection. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, we'll receive it.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D3540, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. And now I would like to call up 1D7903 in e-court. This is an expert report on the impact of mortar shells in the Sarajevo zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Dr. Subotic, is this the first page of your expert report on the effects of mortar shells or projectiles in the area of Sarajevo?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I suppose so -- yes, yes. I have an electronic version which is difficult to read. Before we start, I have a request, if I may. utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The first incident that you addressed in your report is incident 1, as marked in your report. Can you tell us what your conclusions were on the basis of the physical evidence retrieved there and what is the significance of the incident?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Based on the physical trace evidence retrieved at the site and based on the position of the incident and in view of the capabilities of the weapon itself, and the documentation drafted by the CSB in two sets, one of which was shortly after the on-site investigation and the other after the clearing up was conducted and as a result of a personal visit to the incident site and the information we gathered, it was concluded that at this incident site an 82-millimetre shell exploded fired from a distance of between 100 and 120 metres from the incident site along the trajectory that was determined by the CSB and that we agreed with. It was a direction that was quite normal in relation to Vase Miskina Street. We concluded that the sniper fire that was recorded in a TV footage filmed during the evacuation of those injured had to have come from a close proximity because the positions of the BH army were -- because the positions were 1700 or 1800 metres away --

utterances.text: Can the witness repeat the positions of which side.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can you tell us what was the angle, what the angle of descent had to be and could it have been achieved from such a distance?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a distance from which one could not fire infantry weapons and anticipate where it would hit. That would be high angles of descent. So no one using infantry weapons would not use it outside its range of efficiency.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you recommend any other image of the pavement or something else that you included in the report? We then established that his crater corresponds with two stills from a video filmed on the day of the incident before the clearing up. The two craters correspond completely. And we also established on the spot that that part of the pavement - it's not really a pavement but it's a pedestrian zone - that is the location where the changed crater is, the paving slabs around the crater in its vicinity have been changed. And we've shown that -- we depict that in image number 14. We could establish the angle of descent on the basis of these images, and on the basis of that we then determined the distance. utterances.text: Thank you. I would now draw your attention to G4, and later on with the Chamber I will request a clarification. What did you establish about this incident?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This incident is elaborated in small detail in the report because in my view it is, first of all, such that there is a deviation during the technical on-site investigation, but let me not dwell on that. What is characteristic about this incident is that the first investigation that was conducted, if we do not take into account the fact that one UNPROFOR member visited the site, was conducted two years after the incident. During the first investigation which the CSB conducted two years after the event at a location which was claimed to be the incident site, at the football-pitch the traces of one shell were found, and that is covered in the technical report produced by the CSB. We discussed that with Mr. Sabljica who was in charge of the investigation and he did not have any explanation about the lack of traces of the second shell. The investigation took place in 1995 and in 2001 two traces were found in this location. The two traces were examined by Mr. Higgs and by UNPROFOR members and Mr. Barry Hogan also photographed it, so that the appearance of the second crater at the football-pitch has not been explained to date. Another interesting aspect of this event is this: We established that there was no football-match being played at the parking as was claimed, but that they rather played it at the indoor football ground which is located next to the football-pitch. Mr. Fazlic mentions these details in Mr. Hogan's video in detail. We established, first of all, that his testimony does not correspond; and next, that it was an indoor football-match. And we concluded that it was the indoor football ground right next to the parking where the incident took place.
