utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And if you could explain what you had in mind there. 38. Next image, please.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Perhaps I can comment on this image, too, so that we don't have to return to it. This image depicted the measurements of the incoming trajectory and we'll return to that because now that we have this image it's precisely what I was telling you about. Up here is the small plateau and down here is the parking-lot where it was claimed that the football-match took place. And that was where the incident had occurred. However, we have shown in our report and opinion that actually the football-match was played up there right next to the parking-lot where you can see the pitch for five-a-side football. You can see the goals that was photographed first by Mr. Barry Hogan. You can see the five-a-side football goals. Everything else indicates that that was where the football-match took place, rather than down at the parking-lot where the on-site investigation was conducted and where it was claimed that the incident had happened. When I say "claimed," I refer to witness statements.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we see, please, image 29 and then we'll return to image 38. So image 29 is the one we would need now. That's the end of paragraph 36. What does this image depict? This is from the TV news of the BH television?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is here because it follows the testimony of Mr. Fazlic. Because one can see here that actually there is a small goal here, a five-a-side football goal, in front of the blue car so that's a football played with small goals, which was not the game judging by what he said. This is a different category, the five-a-side football. We can see only one trace of blood here which was filmed by the TV crew and probably it was caused by a shell, which according to witness testimonies landed on the previous day and hit a boy -- I mean the trace of blood could not be like this if it was produced by the two shells, and according to witness testimonies and judging by the number of injured persons. That's all. Because here you cannot really have a good impression. The following moment shows, the following frame shows the entire area and one can see that it is the only trace.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What photograph would that be?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Excuse me?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: We do not have the photograph showing this next frame and showing the entire parking-lot.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, but the film, the video, is available so it can be extracted, no problem at all.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we please show the witness image 37 now, please, so you can explain to us what the investigators are doing.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Image 37 is something that took place later. After we talked to Mr. Sabljica we received it from -- actually, the Prosecution received it from the CSB and thanks to their courtesy we received it. It shows the measuring of the incoming trajectory by using the central axis in 1995 and its trajectory that we do not accept and do not agree with. Because judging by what we found on the ground, the traces of the impact do not match the trajectory which they establish. When we looked at this image a little bit more closely, we could see that the compass here is at the right fork rather than the central one when you look at this. And when we look at this -- when we looked at this on the ground, then we decided that they registered the incoming trajectory which is photographed here and they made a corresponding error with the -- with regard to the incoming trajectory because the compass is located on a wrong stick.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. I would draw the participants' attention to image 38 which depicts the whole parking-lot as mentioned recently by the witness.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, it's the same as --

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: 28, 28. Can you tell us what would be the reason for the investigation to be conducted two years after the incident and how did that affect the accuracy of the investigation findings?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, the investigation was obviously conducted at someone's request because I don't understand how it could be conducted two years after the event unless someone requested it. That's the first part of the answer to the first part of your question. As for the second part of your question, everyone present here knows that no investigation is conducted before -- I mean, two years later because the situation on the incident site had changed. It could happen accidentally or forensic technicians like to say that the space becomes contaminated. The traces are jeopardised, the ones that -- that exist at the site and which are crucial if we are to establish the exact factual situation. So the data showed later on that there were some strange results here starting from another trace which appeared and which were nowhere to be found in 1995. And as I say, there was just one investigation which was conducted by the UNPROFOR but its results are not applicable because they are located 200 metres away. So they cannot apply them and see where the error is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. In your report you mention that that match that was played was part of some religious festivities, al-Fitr festivities. Did you have any documents to that effect?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course. The documents are all referred to. There is an order to organise those festivities. There are persons who were in charge of organising that football-match.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Shall we move on? I'm not sure if it comes from Doctor's expertise.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] There is a reference to that in the Doctor's expertise, Your Excellency. I agree that this has nothing to do with ballistics, but it is mentioned that the Doctor and her team did come across documents covering the issue of festivities and football-matches.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I apologise. May I say something with this regard?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] First and foremost, we paid attention to that because the main witness of this incident changed his evidence over time. We concluded that by reading his statement he provided in various cases and in various situations. It was Mr. Fazlic who also participated in the recording of Mr. Barry Hogan's film and nothing matches nothing else in that film.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Chamber is of the view that this kind of evidence is outside of expertise. So please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is correct that it goes beyond the ballistics expertise, which is why I will leave that topic aside.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, can we now look at incident G5?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It starts with paragraph 49. The incident happened on the 12th of July, 1993. It involved water queue in Spasenije Cane Babovic Street. What did the physical evidence show in this case? I would also like to call up figure 41. Let us move on along the text and let's show figure 41, which is at the end of paragraph 55.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This incident occurred in Spasenije Cane Babovic Street. The position of that street is depicted in figure 43 in Google Earth. We'll come back to that later. A shell exploded, an 82-millimetre shell, I believe. According to the investigators, it exploded on the body of a victim. Figure 41 depicts that body. The body is covered and it is right to the investigator and to the Skoda car depicted in the figure.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] For the benefit of the other participants, can the photo be zoomed in across the whole screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Go on, Doctor.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We all agree on that. We believe that the projectile was activated on the victim's body and that body is on the right-hand side of the image, to the right of the investigator and the damaged Skoda. The investigator established that the shell had arrived over the house on the right-hand side which you can't see very well in this image, the house that is behind the fence. However, the physical evidence on the pavement and the physical evidence on the car indicate that that was actually not the case. We analysed all of the traces one by one and we established what the trajectory of that shell was, the incoming trajectory, that is.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we now look at image 43 which is part of paragraph 60.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the position of Spasenije Cane Babovic Street and the physical evidence that can be seen and that are described in great detail in this expert report show that the shell had come at an angle of -- at of less than 90 degrees in the direction of that street depicted in the photo. And you can see that also in another figure, figure 52. When we were there, we marked the traces and we also used the measuring tape to make things as clear as possible. Figure 52 shows what I have just described. The trajectory, as you can see, is depicted in the image on the right-hand side at an angle that is certainly less than 90 degrees from the top of the image to the bottom.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we now first look at figure 46 and invite your comment.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Figure 46 is one photo from the photo documentation. We used white circles to mark the traces on the asphalt that had been created on impact. They are typical of an explosion that happened mid-air and not on the ground. Their form shows the incoming trajectory quite clearly and this is marked by line 4. Another thing that confirms the trajectory of the mine or the shell are the damages on the Skoda car that you can see. And you can see that the blast -- and if we are talking about Skoda, so the shock wave went from the left to the right, from the bottom to the top, and the deformation on the Skoda show it clearly. On the right flank you have the deformation of the metal that shows the height at which the shell exploded. We took a photo of a similar Skoda and at the height of 65 centimetres is where that shell exploded.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You're talking about figure 47?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, figure 46. It is on the screen -- I apologise. Figure 47 where you can see the 65 centimetres. Obviously we couldn't do it on this photo, we could not measure things on this photo because the Skoda was too damaged.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It says a similar or the same Skoda?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's the same model of a Skoda car. It's the same Skoda but not the same car, actually.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue and tell us what is the allegation which would charge myself or us -- what is alleged as the trajectory of the shell, what houses in question?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We can see the house ever so slightly behind the fence and behind the gate. Maybe there is another photo that depicts this alleged house better.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Perhaps 48.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is the same photo that could be seen in 47; however, what we did here is a representation - and I'm pointing you to the red marks and the direction marked by number 5 as well as the traces marked by number 6 - this is the hypothetical trajectory determined by the investigators and described in their documents. If that shell had arrived across the house as they claim then the traces would have to be found in the place of our red marks but they are not there. You can see where they are. We encircled the real traces at the site of the deformation, and we also showed what the deformation on the Skoda should look like if the shell had arrived from the direction that they had allegedly determined. This picture shows everything.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we scroll up a little. Let's see how you obtained this figure.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is a mirror image because the angle is 90 per cent or less. If the shell had landed from the side across the house and the fence, then the biggest deformation would be at number 1. It would go from the right to the left, from the top to the bottom, and this is what it would look like. In order to make things clear, we showed what kind of deformation this car would have had to suffer if the direction or the incoming trajectory was as they claim it was.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you please read the caption under 49.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Figure 49, it says, "fence in the lower right-hand side" and the -- and arrow, the pointed arrow, points in the direction of fence and the caption below the photo.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Where would the fence be if it was there?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, where the fence would be in that position. All this is a hypothetical representation of the situation as it should have been in case the shell had flown over that house and if that trajectory was as the investigators claim it was.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So it's not a real picture, but rather produced by you hypothetically using the existing photo?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's correct. The real photo is at number 48 and it confirms the trajectory as marked by number 4. And this photo, number 49, is just an illustration of the situation as it should be as opposed to what was -- it was alleged as it had been.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And the real fence, where would it be with regard to this mirror image?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It should be in the direction of the pointed arrow on the right-hand side. The car is positioned in that way that its position could not be changed. Do you see what I mean? The car was where it was, and around it there are real deformations and the real deformations indicate that the trajectory is in the direction of number 4. The deformations on the car and the traces on the ground confirm that. The car has to be in its place so as to allow us to discuss what the investigators claim. It is in the same place, but the deformations would have to be totally different. The fence is in the same place as it is in figure 48. Did I make myself clear at all? Do you understand what I'm saying?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can I now ask you to --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can we go back to figure or image 46. No, shall we show the paragraph above the picture as well, let's zoom out a little bit further. Here I rely on the English translation, I think you explained what yellow line number 4 means. Collapse the English and leave it as it is, but I can't find the explanation as to number 1, 2, and 3. Did you touch -- did you mention -- did you touch upon it, meaning of number 1, 2, 3, and the meaning of arrows in your report? Otherwise, I'd like you to explain it here.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, it's a bit lower, where it says figure 40 [as interpreted] shows that the left rear end of the car, this is the text immediately after figure 46 under (e), we start with the damage to the Skoda car after a detailed analysis --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, I found it.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And then you have the --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I found it. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] -- direction 1, and so on and so forth.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Excellencies, shall we move to the next incident or is this a good time for our next break?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: We'll have a break. We'll have a break for 45 minutes and resume at quarter past 1.00. --- Luncheon recess taken at 12.29 p.m.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Please continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, can we now focus our attention on the incident of the 22nd of January, 1994, at Alipasino Polje. Do you have it there within reach? I think it's G6.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I have it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us briefly what the most significant points are and what does the physical evidence point to as the most telling in that incident?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: There were different findings produced by the security service and the forensic examinators. They could not agree on the issue of which shell impacted there. There was also the investigation conducted by Mr. Verdy, a member of UNPROFOR, who also provided his findings. Based on the evidence found at the impact site and based on the elements noted in the documentation and the photo documentation we had to establish, first of all, what the shells were which landed there and from which direction. We established that three 120 shells exploded there and that there were no technical elements that would warrant the conclusion that 82-millimetre shells exploded there. We were lucky enough in that as we toured the scene we were able to establish at Klare Cetkina Street number 4 that there was a presence of trace evidence and through the central axis method we were able to establish the incoming trajectory.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Would that be image 54 that would depict that or at some other?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes, 54 is fine as well as 55. In image 54 you can see elements of the central crater and you can see that fragmentation shrapnel was present there. The CSB was also able to establish that, and it was on this basis that we established that it was 120-millimetre shell rather than 82-millimetre.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The CSB thought that the traces would be scattered about a metre from the centre of the crater and you established that it was --

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We established that it was more than 3 metres, and it was on this basis that we established that the crater must have been the result of 120-millimetre shell impacting rather than 82-millimetre.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [In English] "That you were able to" [no interpretation] "that the CSB was also able to establish that and it was on this basis, but the CSB established 1 and a half metres." [Interpretation] In line 13 this should be reflected and it's not there. So do you confirm this?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes. It can't be seen, or rather, it can be seen that the traces reach as far as 3 metres from the centre of crater.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us if something was changed at the impact site?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, obviously flagstone was included in the curb there, although the situation as it is now allowed us to measure what the radius was, or rather, what the diameter was.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And with regard to the trajectory, can we look at image 55 and see what the conclusions there were?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Perhaps figure 56 would be more helpful in that respect. Figure 55 shows only the method whereby the central crater was measured and what the pattern was, whereas in figure 56 we can see the incoming trajectory. It was established on our part that it was 237 degrees through the application of the central axis method.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Which figure is that?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Figure 56.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: So it's the next page. [In English] Yeah, that's right. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Our tape indicates the central axis and the angle of descent. We established it by establishing the azimuth of the building which can be seen in the background. It is along the same azimuth. It seems to me that Mr. Sabljica during his testimony agreed that this was accurately presented when looking at our work. On the point of impact of the second shell which impacted on the carriageway, unfortunately we could not retrieve any physical trace evidence because a new layer of asphalt was laid.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Sorry, is this image 58?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can it be shown, please. Carry on.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the right-hand side the point of impact of the shell can be seen. This is a photograph taken from the photo file and it can be found in the documentation given by the forensic examiner, the one above. It has a scale as well. It is pretty unclear, but one can conclude that it's a crater of the size of between 70 and 90 centimetres. We checked it by comparing it against the manhole that can be seen in the background. This also casts suspicion on the fact that it was a 82-millimetre shell and that was the reason why we checked it further. We were lucky enough that Mr. Barry Hogan photographed the area before a new layer of asphalt was placed, and this can be seen on figures 59 and onwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: While we're still with this figure, can you tell us where the pattern -- the spray pattern can be seen in respect of the centre of the crater, to the left or to the right?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It's an unclear picture but it's definitely to the right, I would say, based on the photograph. And I can confirm that it's scattered to the right-hand side by reference to Barry Hogan's photographs.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we have the next photograph.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Mr. Barry Hogan photographed the area of impact before it was recoated with asphalt, and it can be compared against the manhole cover which we know is about 70 centimetres. So it must have been the 122-millimetre shell [as interpreted], as confirmed by Mr. Barry Hogan in his report. I think the CSB was confused by the damage to the asphalt and they believed that it was the centre of crater, and as a result, thought it was the result of an 82-millimetre shell. On the basis of this photograph - and you know that the footage also has the time when it was taken and the various co-ordinates - and by reference to the position of the planets we explained the shadow which can be seen in figure 61 next to that post. We could establish a central crater and the fragmentation effect. We marked the pattern and the crack which can be seen in figure 59. Our central axis is slightly to the left of that crack, and in figure 61 it can be seen that it is almost parallel to the post there. It was on this basis that we established that the azimuth of the sun, or rather, of this here is 240. And when we compared it to the results obtained by Captain Verdy the difference in respect of both mines was in several degrees only.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we look at figure 61. First briefly figure 60 so we can see Mr. Hogan. And then figure 61. There we have it, figure 61.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, this one.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In line 24 it's 120-millimetres, that's what the mine was. I have an intervention for the transcript.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Carry on, Doctor.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: When we compared the traces on the ground and the angles we obtained with the angles obtained by Captain Verdy, the differences were only 1 to 2 degrees and we decided to carry on with his measurements because he had, after all, taken them on the ground. We found that Captain Verdy had recorded the angles of azimuth and had rotated them somewhat in relation to the site of the incident. Now, how did we establish this ? Since the shells were obviously fired from the same weapon and this was a conclusion that both Mr. Higgs and ourselves arrived at based on the distance compared to where they landed and the impact dispersion, we established that the two projectiles were fired from the same weapon, these trajectories intersect in one point which is the point where the projectiles were launched. If we look at the traces on the asphalt and the angles, they would not be consistent and that's why we agreed that because of the consistency of the angles that he established and the traces produced by the projectiles, that he had in fact mistaken the points from where the projectiles were launched when measuring the angles.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In line 25 did you say that he took them on the ground shortly after the event, and I mean Verdy?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. He investigated the scene shortly after the incident took place.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Tell us, is this image 62 that you wanted us to look at or 63?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No matter, both images illustrate the same -- well, perhaps we should look at 62 first and then 63 to make this clear. Image 62 indicates the trajectories from the incident site of both shells under the angle of azimuth as established by Mr. Verdy and thoroughly checked by us and the two intersect at 2.237 metres where the IP institute is located which was under the BH army control -- UP institute.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And that is Sokolovic Kolonija; is that right?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: So it would appear on this Google image.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we have image 63.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: We have the war map of the 14th Division placed side by side with the Google Earth image to indicate that it's the same.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And who claimed that it had arrived from the Institute for the Blind?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I think it was the CSB and even UNPROFOR who maintained that. We were lucky enough to be there, to visit there, before the arrival of certain investigators to testify here, and they confirmed that we had established these trajectories correctly.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could this difference in the trajectory look at -- let's look at table 5 when it comes to the filling, the charge, and the trajectory.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The differences listed were not coincidental. There must have been the adjustment of fire, most certainly. The two impacts are within range. 15 metres minus one range error probable and there must have been an adjustment of fire. Had the shell been defective in any way and that was the reason why it deflected, it would most certainly not be able to reach that far. It would have landed earlier. Technically speaking that would have been impossible.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Under (b) -- it was under (b) that you made your correction south-westerly direction and that's what this image shows; right?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: One moment. Is the UPI institute the Institute for the Blind? What's the UPI institute then?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] United agriculture and industry. It was an agricultural institute or a food industry -- institute.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you confirm that, Dr. Subotic ?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, yes, of course.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Please continue.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is definitely not the Institute for the Blind.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we see image 51 for a brief moment. It's the previous incident, 5.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Had the shell flown over the house from the direction suggested by the security centre of Sarajevo, where would one expect to see the stabiliser which is in this case to the right of the car?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: If the incident was such as the investigators found and if the shell has come from the direction across the house, the stabiliser would have to be on the other side of the car where the shell was activated on the body of the deceased woman. It could not have been on this side. Because when the shell is activated, depending on the charge, the stabiliser remains at the spot where the shell was activated. It is then propelled backwards a little bit -- rather, it continues to fly on in -- along the incoming trajectory a little bit, and then it gets stuck in the ground depending on the charge. So this stabiliser could never be found on this side of the car if the activation of the shell had occurred on the other side of the car. So the position of the stabiliser which landed in the vicinity nearby tells us that the shell had arrived from this direction.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you read out the word that appears at the bottom right of this picture out loud.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Below the image next to number 51, is that what you mean? Oh, that's a marking -- that's the TV agency which filmed the video because this is a still extracted from a video. It's one of the TV stations and it says "FIVA."

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could we now deal with the incident G7 which is the Oslobodilaca Sarajeva Street in Dobrinja. And the beginning is in paragraph 76, so if we could please now move on to that paragraph in this document. 76. Actually, we can immediately move one or two pages on to the image or figure 64, and if you can explain to us briefly on this map what is depicted here and then we'll move on to a photograph.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is a section of the map of the city of Sarajevo showing the streets mentioned in the report about this incident, particularly what I have in mind is Hamdija Kapidzica or Dzavarharl Nehrua Street. Excuse me, it's difficult to pronounce.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: It is --

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is particularly mentioned here for the reason that -- and that was why we included it here because nothing happened in this street and it's mentioned in documents. Therefore, we wanted to show it. You couldn't say it's not far. But nothing happened there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And what is the point at which indicating the site of the incident, is it one of the red dots? Oslobodilaca Sarajeva Street?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, the dots are already in the map. The Oslobodilaca Sarajeva Street is -- the incident site is marked with number 353 in this, and it's the street going upwards and intersecting the Mimar Sinana Boulevard.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we now please look at figure 65, please. What does this photograph depict?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is a photograph from the photo file where the red arrow around the middle of the photograph in the left-hand corner shows the impact of the mine --

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] -- the impact of the shell on the curb, but this was not investigated by the CSB. They just marked it and then did not investigate it.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can anything else be seen in this photograph and what?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The trace of earth which helps to determine the direction from which the shell landed. If you zoom in, you can also see that the CSB officials in the far right-hand corner also marked the incident site in Mihajla Pupina Street.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could we now please see photograph 69 as it can facilitate things for us so that we can see this. It is shown the same area from a different angle. Could you tell us what we can see here.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Aha. Excuse me, I opened the document where the next photograph is. That's actually the site, the location where the impact of the shell is marked on the previous photograph which has been repaved in the meantime with a new layer of asphalt. This is what we photographed in September 2010, but on the upper photograph you can see what it looked like when Mr. Barry Hogan made a photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: You mean figure 68?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, yes, yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we please scroll up on the same page so that we can see the other photo.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This is a still from Mr. Barry Hogan's video. It's obviously immediately before the corner where the shell landed was repaved. It's the shell that we discussed in relation to the previous image where it's marked with a red arrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. What does the CSB conclude, or rather, all the investigations, what conclusions did they yield and on what basis?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, according to their findings which are included in their reports, they analysed the material physical traces, and on the basis of such traces they concluded that -- rather, concluded where the projectiles had arrived from. However ...

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could we now please look at paragraph 69(b) because perhaps you could help us there. What was the basis on which, or rather, was their conclusion correct?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Considering the traces that we found in the photo files, we concluded that they did not determine the directions well which can be seen nicely in the photograph which is, or rather, the image which is on the screen now. This is the sketch of the site and we superimposed onto it the impact sites of these projectiles which are drawn onto Google Earth.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could we zoom in onto the sketch even more. And please tell us, where is the north on the sketch?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: You can see it in the left corner of the image; however, north as marked on the image is turned for 60 degrees which can be seen when we look at the actual situation and straighten out the street. Then you can see how much the image from Google Earth had to be rotated properly because the actual figure north is marked by the figure N. So due to this error of 60 degrees they drew erroneous conclusions about the direction from which the shells had arrived. I think that KDZ166, the witness, agreed with this when we presented to him the situation as depicted here.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. This rotation of the azimuth, the north in the sketch, is that sufficient for a wrong conclusion to be drawn?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, you see, of course it is. If you make such a conclusion on the basis of the sketch of the incident site. I cannot image that someone marked the sketch of the incident site wrongly and then on the basis of that considered all other physical traces in relation to some other north because their conclusions correspond with the situation. Of course the reports note that they used other traces as well, and those other traces as we noted were not properly interpreted.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: This is why I would like us to have a look at figures 74 and then 75 so that you can explain to us what they depict and then we shall move on to figures -- the two following figures. So figure 74 first, please, that's a sketch. Can you just briefly explain to us what this incoming trajectory means and where would the dispersion pattern be found?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, this image depicts, first of all, the principle of the dispersion and fragmentation of the shell and the dispersion pattern at the moment of explosion. This image shows how the impact would have looked if the shell had arrived from the direction of Energoinvest as claimed in the findings. In that case, we would have fragment dispersion on the left wall and not on the right. Judging by what we photographed, the situation is quite the contrary. The fragment effect is to be found on the right lateral wall.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we now please show image 75.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This image also used -- is used for the analysis of fragmentation effect in case that the shell had arrived from the positions of the BH army, its fragmentation effect fully fits in with the fragmentation effect which we can see in image 76 or figure 76. This is a photograph that we made while we were still there -- while we were there, and it is still to be found there now.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we please show figure 76 now. Is that the right wall that you talked about?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's the right wall that I talked about.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we now please show image 79.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you explain what this figure shows?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the basis of the traces in the snow in this figure we marked the incoming trajectory where the site of the impact is marked by the head of the arrow or the tip of the arrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And how does that reflect to the right and the left areas from the point of impact?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I said previously, the trace can be found below the explosion along the incoming trajectory and to the right and the left according to the diagram which we saw earlier as depicted in figure 75 -- actually, the fragmentation effect is as mentioned just now on the lateral wall, the right one, and forwards. The remaining part stays where it is and therefore there is no effect on the front left wall.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The left wall?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it's the front wall if we go from left to the right.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we now please look at figure 80 which is signed by Mr. Sabljica, unless I'm mistaken. If this incoming trajectory were correct, where would the traces of fragments and shrapnel and blackness be found?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, Mr. Sabljica did not agree with us and he marked the incoming trajectory which he had primarily established. But we can all see that the point of impact was moved to the right for at least 2 metres so that he could justify his claim that the projectile had arrived from that direction. However, for Mr. Sabljica to move the arrow to the point of impact, if he had done that, once again there would be no effect on the left wall. There would be no pattern of fragments there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we now please look at figure 81 so that you can briefly explain to us what is depicted thereon.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, figure 81 represents the site of impact of the shell which hit a footpath, and at this site of impact we can also see the pattern and the stabiliser and the stabiliser is embedded there and the site of impact was established on the basis of some knowledge of geometry and this is the approximate direction which was determined here and the following was established: Namely, that the shell which we discussed just now and which landed on the curb of the concrete plateau and which was not established destroyed the earth between the concrete footpath and the point of impact. And the shell which landed here and hit the curb scattered the earth along its own incoming trajectory and then it was established on the basis of analysis that the direction was the same, the incoming trajectory was the same as with the shell which exploded in Mihajla Pupina Street.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Do we need to see figure 83? Would you recommend that we should see it?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes, yes, why not.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I would like to call up figure 83.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You can see clearly that the direction of earth in the direction of the old crater, according to Mr. Barry Hogan, he was the one who established that that was an old crater, that trajectory differs quite clearly from the direction of Lukavica for which it was claimed that that was the incoming trajectory of the shell. The traces that we discussed a while ago that you see up here determined the incoming trajectory of the two shells, the second that landed here, and the last at the same time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Very well. Let's look at 84 and then 85 and 86. I'm inviting your comments and I also would like to ask you to call for a new image once you're done with the previous one.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This is the shell that landed on the footpath and its stabiliser remained embedded in the footpath. This is a classical appearance of a stabiliser embedded in a gravel surface covered with a layer of asphalt. You can see that the stabiliser has some numerical markings on its charge. We studied the markings and actually we realised that it was a Latinic letter N.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we now look at figures 85 and 86. I'm sorry, I did not ask for 85. I would like to see 86. When this is blown up you can see the Roman letter N on the primary charge of the stabiliser.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What does this indicate?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As far as I know, in the armament of the former Yugoslavia and the Army of Republika Srpska there were no shells with Roman numerals or letters; they were all in the Cyrillic script.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: The appearance of the crater and the appearance of the stabiliser in it, are they typical or uncharacteristic?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: They are typical of a shell whose stabiliser becomes embedded in the surface, which means that a bigger charge was used in shelling this location.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Were there any traces of manipulation in this crater?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I didn't see any traces or manipulation in this crater, but it has just occurred to me that during the investigations, the investigators were determining the trajectory and they referred to the position of the stabiliser which is depicted in figure 87. Perhaps you would like to see that. Mr. Sabljica said that the trajectory that he determined is confirmed by the position of the stabiliser and that can also be seen in a photo that was taken by the police. But this is certainly incorrect because the stabiliser itself shows deformities which were not in contact with the surface.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: I would like to go back to figure 78. This is some ten pages before the page that we're currently on. Figure 78, 7-8.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. You can see on the stabiliser itself that the wings on the top part are damaged, which means that fins were not in contact with the surface but are still damaged, which leads us to conclude that that stabiliser had already hit the surface, ricochetted, and found itself in this place. However, this cannot be used as a parameter to determine the trajectory of this shell.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And now I would like to draw your attention to incident G9 which happened on the 2nd of December, 1994, I believe. G9, please, paragraph 93 where you also find a photo. This stabiliser is not where it originally landed?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, because its upper surface shows damaged fins which were never in contact with the surface.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Could you please comment upon this incident and what would the physical evidence indicate?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: During this incident there were allegedly two explosions. In practical terms they were simultaneous or followed each other within a few seconds or within a minute. The two explosions, according to the investigators, were caused by 76-millimetre projectiles. Let me just look for the model and the year of production. The 76-millimetre projectile, M70. However, the physical evidence on the ground which can be found in the photo file deny that or refuted that.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we please look at figures 92 and 93. Do we know if we look at that aerial photo where those impacts happened?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: One impact was in Danila Ilic street, the one in photo 92, and that was in the vicinity of the aerial photo that we have just seen in e-court. The crater that is here does not look like the explosion of a shell that landed at number 2, which means there is a series of ambiguities about this place and a lot of evidence. There are some objects which are scattered in the top part of the photo but they are scattered just opposite to the centre of explosion and that pattern could have occurred only if there was something that exploded under the stool but it didn't because that was never registered.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can the Doctor be provided with a pen to mark the convexity of the objects that she just described as being scattered all over the snowy surface.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Could you please draw a line or an arrow to indicate where the centre of explosion would be in this particular case?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This would be the line and this could have happened only if the explosion happened here and in this direction. If it exploded in a different direction this convexity could not have existed.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Can we now look at figure 93 --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If you would like to move from here, we need to keep this first.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Could you date and initial this picture.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And the date.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Today we are at the 14th?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: 14th.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. Shall we assign a number for this?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Exhibit D3541, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let's look at figure 93 together.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: What is depicted in this figure? Which explosion? What does the physical evidence tell you?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: This photo is just an illustration in order to demonstrate the range of traces from a shell with a similar charge as the projectile that contained about 650 grams of TNT as far as I can remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. And now can we look at the following photo which is 96. I apologise. Let's first look at photos 94 and 95 to see if we could draw any conclusion from them, 94 and 95 are on the same page.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Figures 94 and 95 show the results of an analysis of what we have just discussed. I don't know how much detail do you want to hear. I can tell you that we concluded that some things could not be as they are represented. We analysed the centre of explosion, and if it had been on the pipes that could -- they would not be covered with snow. The darker traces of the explosion could not be here where they are and they are marked by number 1. And the earth which was the consequence of a shock wave or an explosive process was -- is fragmented as shown in 94 on the right-hand side. We also stated that there was some tampering with the traces, that the crater was manipulated, that the earth was moved from the crater. In any case, the conclusion which is corroborated by these two photos is that what happened here was an explosion of Trotyl round which was not even in a metal casing at all and, as such, weird traces on the ground are actually the consequence of an opening which directed the combustion process as I indicated a little while ago. One more factor indicates that is true, there was a witness who thought he had heard the -- first the firing of the round and that there was a subsequent explosion. Those two explosions he perceived them differently in [indiscernible] terms, and he never moved from his vantage point. That would not have been the case if the two were really identical. This is also corroborated by the fact that there is no fragmentation pattern on the window that is nearby.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Figure 96, please. Zoom-in. Doctor, could you please explain what the figures depict?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Both photos depict - and I apologise - they're both from the photo file. On the left-hand side are the shutters closed and there's some piercings, some damage from the fragmentation. According to the investigators, on the right-hand side when the shuttered are open and you can see fragmentation pattern on the inside of the shutters. However, interestingly enough, neither the concrete surround of the window nor the wall around the window show any traces of fragmentation. We established that when we visited the site and this can be seen in somewhat greater detail in photo 97. You can see that there are no fragmentation traces in any place there.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Figure 97, please.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I hope I don't have to explain that fragmentation effects or pattern does not follow a said direction and it would be impossible for the fragmentation pattern to exist on the shutters and not to exist around the window itself.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you. What is your conclusion about this incident and what were the conclusions that were drawn by the CSB, i.e., in investigation group?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: The investigators concluded that two shells exploded in this place -- I apologise, two artillery projectiles, 76-millimetres. However, the traces and evidence at the site show that that was impossible. What we have just stated is not corroborated by the size of the crater. It is too large for it to be the effect of the 76-millimetre artillery shell. The crater that was shown in a different place close to the site of the incident is shallow but it is huge, as you can see in photo 98. And it is also impossible for two artillery projectiles which were fired from the same position which means that the starting positions were the same including the angle of launch, which means that the angle of descent had to be the same for the both projectiles. So it would be impossible for such two projectiles to result in such different craters.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we now look at figure 98 to show what the Doctor is just talking about.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: As I've already stated this would be impossible which is corroborated by a photo from the photo file and that photo was singled out by us. These are -- this was shrapnel and you can see it in figure 100 that with the result of the 76-millimetre projectile explosion, we took out the fuse. So it is absolutely impossible for a fuse that activates the projectile to remain intact and to be found about 30 metres away from the point of impact, the point of explosion.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Can we now look at figure 100, please. This is the fuse you were discussing; right?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: And what is the appearance of the pattern? Would that tally with 76-millimetre projectile?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it would. But I would nevertheless have see it personally live, as it were, to see what the casing is like. At any rate, this could not have been fired regularly. And as I said, it is impossible for a projectile to be fired and the fuse remain intact and be found 30 metres away from the point of impact. Well, there is one explanation of how it could have happened. It could have happened in the case the projectile was lying down along its length and activated with Trotyl because that's what the crater would then look like as it is now.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can this be admitted into evidence?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Any objection, Ms. Gustafson?

utterances.speaker: MS. GUSTAFSON
utterances.text: No objection. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, we'll admit this second report.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit D3542, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Can we call up 1D7901.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Were you in charge of this expert report related to the incidents --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. Before we move away from this report, having reviewed the English translation, the Chamber is of the view that it would be more benefitted to have the images to appear in the translation as well. So I would ask CLSS to provide us with a revised translation. Would there be any problem, Mr. Robinson? I'm not sure how that logistics is arranged.

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yeah, I was actually going to volunteer that maybe our Defence team can insert the images in the documents. Maybe that would be the easiest. But if that's -- would somehow offend CLSS then perhaps we can ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: If the Defence is able to do that, I take it that CLSS is able to do that without any much difficulty. You agree with this suggestion, Ms. Gustafson?

utterances.speaker: MS. GUSTAFSON
utterances.text: That's fine. I agree, it would make it easier.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Yes, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. That will help to relieve our resources somewhat because we are at the end of our tethers in terms of our resources. I thought they would do it because it is part and parcel of their work.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, were you in charge of examining the incidents known as Markale I.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Can I intervene at this moment because I wanted to raise this issue at some point in time because this has been causing the Chamber some concern lately. It's related to the translation issues so that's why I'm intervening now. The Chamber has noticed that at the moment quite a large number of written statements of witnesses called by the Defence are just draft translations and, thus, unrevised. In the process of reviewing these statements, the Chamber has also noticed that some of them contain mistakes which are of some concern. By way of example, the Chamber refers to statements of witnesses Savo Bojanovic, the exhibit number of whose statement is D3076; Mile Ujic, D2909; and Tomislav Batinic, D2930. In particular, paragraphs 19, 3, and 4 of those statements respectively. In addition, extremely problematic is the statement of Nevenko Samoukovic, D3062, where there is not only a discrepancy in paragraph numbering between the English and B/C/S versions, but where paragraph 8 of the English translation is not present in the B/C/S version while paragraph 7 of the B/C/S version is missing from the English version. The Chamber, therefore, orders the Defence to obtain revised translations of these four statements as soon as possible and upload them into e-court, notifying the Chamber and the other parties in this case. The Chamber finds this extensive reliance on draft translation to be highly unsatisfactory and is under the impression that it is the Defence that controls whether a translation prepared by the CSB is a draft translation or a revised one. So I'm asking you, Mr. Robinson, does it mean that the Defence request to the CLSS are for draft translations alone? And if so, why is that so?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: Mr. President, when we submit a statement to CLSS, we ask for a regular translation. However, then when the witness comes here and we make changes to the statement, then members of our team revise the translation usually by adding some paragraphs. I'm not sure if the mistakes are made at that stage or if they exist from CLSS when we receive the translation. But we ask for regular translations of the first statements we get from our investigators before the witnesses arrive here.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So we are talking about statements which have already been admitted? So there is no problem on the part of the Defence to ask for a revised translation of witness statements and documents?

utterances.speaker: MR. ROBINSON
utterances.text: There's no problem.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: As regards the logistics of that exercise, the Chamber is of the view that the accused should make a serious effort at rectifying draft translations of witness statements and should do so as soon as possible and in co-operation with the CLSS. So this would not mean that it is enough for the Defence to make a general request for revision of all the draft translations of statements in evidence in this case. Instead, the Chamber prefers that the Defence -- the Defence team staggers the request to the CLSS in a way that would suit CLSS and result in the most efficient revision process. Once the Defence has liaised with the CLSS, the Chamber would like to be informed about the arrangement made and then updated periodically as to how the revision exercise is progressing. The Chamber also instructs the Defence team that from now it should request revised translation of witness statements from the CLSS as a matter of principle. Yes, let's continue, Mr. Karadzic.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Allow me, Excellencies, to say, that my concern over the accuracy of translations is even higher, not just in terms of statements, but in terms of testimonies and the transcript where a great deal of mistranslations are overlooked and I would like to ask your help in asking the Registry to obtain the revision of these 30- or 40.000 pages of transcript, although this is premature at this stage.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Doctor, I suppose you heard what I asked you?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sorry, can you repeat what you said.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Did you head, were you in charge, of this expert examination of all the various incidents that are known as Markale I and Markale II?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Let's start from Markale I?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sorry, I do have some corrections to make in this report as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: Please go ahead.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: I'm sorry, Mr. President. Sorry to interrupt.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Gaynor.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: There is, in fact, a discrepancy in the paragraph numbering of the English and the B/C/S versions of the report that Dr. Subotic is about to launch into the corrections of, just so we're aware of that before she begins.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Thank you. Let's see whether Doctor is aware of this. Let's continue.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In my version it's paragraph 69, footnote 266 or 267, I don't know, because there were modifications made. At any rate, the text ends --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I already noticed the discrepancy of the para number. Those footnotes appear in paragraph 68 in English version. Let us upload the -- both versions.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: In Serbian, is this the page that you would like to make corrections to?

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: Beneath the figure 79, the footnote, yes, that's it. And that's the footnote which ends with paragraph 1, whereas it should read "last paragraph, third line."

utterances.speaker: MR. KARADZIC
utterances.text: There's a difference in my copy. In my copy it's footnote 267, whereas we see 265 on the screen.

utterances.speaker: ZORICA SUBOTIC [Resumed]
utterances.text: In my copy it's 267 as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: How does the footnote read?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The footnote reads: "Republic of BH, Ministry of the Interior, Sarajevo Security Services Centre, report on forensic investigation of site ..."

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Just a second. And the number of the footnote is 268?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 267.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] And a moment ago we saw it in e-court bearing number 265. Yes, here it is. It's the footnote that we can see on the screen.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: So number 265?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: 5, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: What number do we have in English?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: The same, I suppose, because --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: No. I think we have 268 in English.

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. There's obviously an added complication that the B/C/S version that Dr. Subotic has and Dr. Karadzic has is different to the B/C/S version that's been uploaded to e-court and that I have.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: I don't think we can continue --

utterances.speaker: MR. GAYNOR
utterances.text: Certainly it will take an awful long time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: -- in this way. Given the time shall we adjourn for the day and in the meantime the Defence could fix the problem? And then upload the correct version so we can print another one, the correct document?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: I agree.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Yes, Doctor.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If I can make one point. The correct version is uploaded in e-court. I have an older version because I did not have the version printed out after I had made my corrections in it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: The more serious problem is that the English version does not match the B/C/S version, which makes for the Judges and the Prosecution impossible to follow. So shall --

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: May I just -- I downloaded this version of mine from the e-court and it's still not same as it is now in the e-court.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: Very well. So the Chamber wishes to be informed from the Defence informally the moment it has been corrected so that we can print that report at that time. Well, we'll continue tomorrow at 9.00. The hearing is now adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KWON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 15th day of May, 2013, at 9.00 a.m.
